newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli soldiers leave Hebron army headquarters.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers leave Hebron army headquarters.

text.p: Israeli soldiers left their headquarters in Hebron on Friday and Palestinian police moved in, ending 30 years of occupation, witnesses said.
A convoy of jeeps drove out of the hilltop base toward the central part of the West Bank city that Israel is to keep under a self-rule accord with the PLO.
Palestinian officers entered the compound, symbol of Israel's rule over the city since the 1967 Middle East War, with little fanfare.
Some shook hands with Israeli officers.
Crowds had gone home after having gathered on Thursday night, believing the transfer would take place immediately after the Israeli parliament had overwhelmingly approved the self-rule deal.
